title: Cozy Night In Board
h1: Cozy Night In Charcuterie Board for Two
seo_title: Cozy Night In Charcuterie Board for Two: Shopping & Plan
description: A cozy night in charcuterie board for two: Gruyère, smoked Gouda, soppressata, speck, honeycomb, candied walnuts and apple, with a full-bodied red or dry cider.
hook: Heavy blanket required: a fall and winter board of nutty, smoky cheeses and warm flavors, made for the couch.
why: Gruyère and smoked Gouda are the warmest-tasting cheeses you can buy: nutty, a little sweet and smoky. Soppressata and smoked ham or speck carry the same smoke through the meats, so the whole board tastes like a fireplace.

Apple slices, dried apricots, fig preserves and honeycomb add sweetness, and whole-grain mustard adds a sharp edge. A full-bodied red like Côtes du Rhône or Zinfandel, or a dry hard cider, fits the mood.

timeline.what: Take out the meats. Warm the cider if using.

faq.q: What's a good charcuterie board for a night in?
faq.a: Nutty and smoky cheeses like Gruyère and smoked Gouda, soppressata and speck, apple, dried apricots, honeycomb, candied walnuts, mustard, fig preserves and rye crisps.
Yes. This one is sized as dinner for two. Add a bowl of soup if you want something warm alongside.
A full-bodied red such as Côtes du Rhône or Zinfandel, or a dry hard cider, which suits the apple and the smoky flavors.
